title: John buys Apple as a token

scenes.narration: This is John. He wants some Apple stock, held as a token on Solana.
He searches for AAPL and finds three tokens, from Oakmere, Northgate and Redcliff. Same ticker, same price.

RWA Sonar puts them side by side. First, what does he own? Oakmere records holders on the share register. Northgate gives him a debt note that tracks the price. Redcliff only pays the price difference, and holds no shares for him.
Next, who can act on his tokens. All three can freeze an account. At Northgate and Redcliff, one key can mint new tokens. At Oakmere, minting needs three of five signers.
Then trading. Northgate has the deepest pool and trades closest to the stock. Oakmere's pool is thin, and it trades about half a percent above Apple.
John can live with a thin pool if he is on the register. He picks Oakmere and buys two.
One ticker can mean very different things. Compare them at RWA Sonar dot com.
